sophia-finance: FYI — GreenRoute (G-120) opened a ticket: their May 31 invoice misses a large chunk of streaming tokens. They want explanation & remedy.
eli-sales: CSM says customer telemetry shows continuous activity during 2026-05-31T23:40:00Z–2026-06-01T00:10:00Z but our invoice shows near-zero usage for that window. They're asking for a credit estimate.
lucas-platops: I checked region eu-west ingress. We observed aggressive ratecap eviction on router-eu-3 which dropped metering acks when the in-flight queue exceeded 8k. Router logs: ```[2026-05-31T23:45:12Z] router-eu-3 WARN meter_queue_evicted count=10432 session=gh-987 reason=ratecap_overflow``` Metering agent marked events as dropped instead of queueing for async emit.
reza-sre: Running a quick aggregator against raw gateway events to count unacked streaming tokens. SQL: ```SELECT sum(tokens) as missed_tokens, sum(estimated_usd) as est_usd FROM gateway_raw_events WHERE region='eu-west' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-05-31T23:40:00Z' AND '2026-06-01T00:10:00Z' AND ack_status='dropped';```
metering-bot: quick-scan result: missed_tokens=234567, est_usd=2345.67 (prelim).
nina-billing: I can approve credits up to $3,000 without director. This preliminary amount is within threshold. Please provide CSV export of affected sessions and a recommended rounding policy for the memo.
lucas-platops: Recommend rounding to $2,346.00 (round up to nearest dollar) and issue provisional credit while we run a backfill. I'll prepare CSV and checksum.
sophia-finance: Agreed. Sophia approves provisional credit $2,346.00 to GreenRoute (G-120). Ops: schedule a backfill BF-20260601-euw-ratecap to replay gateway events into metering pipeline for reconciliation. Mark as "audit-only" since we already issued credit.
reza-sre: Backfill scheduled, job BF-20260601-euw-ratecap created and will run in canary first. Runbook RB-eu-ratecap-003. ETA full verification 4h. Risk: potential duplicates if partial acks were later reconciled; we'll produce diff report before any ledger mutation.
eli-sales: I'll notify the CSM & GreenRoute: "We've issued a provisional credit of $2,346.00 and are running an internal reconciliation. Expect final confirmation within 72 hours." :thumbsup:
metering-bot: incident created: incident-2026-05-31-eu-ratecap https://infra.internal/incidents/2026-05-31-eu-ratecap (severity P2).
sophia-finance: Please post the credit memo id and GL posting once done so I can close the dispute. Attach the CSV and backfill diff when available. Thanks.
